name: 85251 · Scottsdale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85251 (Scottsdale) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85251 (Scottsdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85251 (Scottsdale) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
